text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 19 · 清晨开门前的甜点店.
Environment:  An original small Central European patisserie interior before opening, symmetrical pale cream and very muted dusty-pink walls, curved walnut-framed glass display counter at left holding a modest assortment of realistic pastries on ivory plates, plain cream pastry boxes tied with fine twine on shelves. A few round marble-top tables and empty bentwood chairs at right, central aisle leads to sunlit glass door. Restrained brass details, pale terrazzo, natural soft morning daylight, elegant geometric order, original business with no visible lettering, no people in reflections.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 4 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 19 · 清晨开门前的甜点店. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. A 2x2 sheet of FOUR distinct eye-level camera views of the SAME ONE space: original forward direction, a lateral oblique view, a reverse view 180 degrees opposite, and the other lateral view. Labels A B C D only. Preserve ALL door/window/furniture positions; actually move camera, never mirror the building. Same material and lighting. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
